==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|en|confidency||obsolete}}

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*bʰeydʰ-}}
From {{inh|en|enm|confidence}}, from {{der|en|la|cōnfīdentia}} (possibly via {{der|en|fro|confidence}}), from {{m|la|cōnfīdō||believe, confide in}} from {{m|la|con-||with}} + {{m|la|fīdō||trust}}.

{{surf|en|confide|ence|nocat=1}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{enPR|kŏn'fĭdəns}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈkɒn.fɪ.dəns/|a=RP}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈkɑn.fɪ.dəns/|a=GA,Atlantic Canada}}
*** {{audio|en|en-us-confidence.ogg|a=California}}
*** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Grendelkhan-confidence.wav|a=Connecticut}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈkɒn.fɪ.dəns/|a=CA,dialects of the US}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈkɔn.fɪ.dəns/|a=AU}}
** {{IPA|en|[ˈkɔ̟n.fə.dəns]|a=NZ}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# [[self-assurance|Self-assurance]].
#: {{ux|en|He entered the [[ring]] with '''confidence'''.}}
# A feeling of [[certainty]]; firm [[trust]] or [[belief]]; [[faith]].
#: {{ux|en|She had '''confidence''' it would soon end.}}
#: {{ux|en|I reposed a great deal of '''confidence''' in his judgment.}}
#* {{RQ:King James Version|Psalms|118|8|9|url=https://archive.org/stream/Bible1611/Binder1#page/n708/mode/1up|It is better to truſt in the {{smallcaps|Lord}} : then to put '''confidence''' in man. / It is better to truſt in the {{smallcaps|Lord}} : then to put '''confidence''' in Princes.}}
#* {{RQ:A. C. Clarke City and Stars|page=39|passage=Khedron hesitated for a moment, wondering how far he should take Jeserac into his '''confidence'''. He knew that Jeserac was kindly and well-intentioned, but he also knew that he must be bound by the same taboos that controlled everyone on Diaspar.}}
# Information held in [[secret]]; a piece of information shared but to thence be kept in secret.
#* {{RQ:Conrad Heart of Darkness|page=201|passage=In the course of these '''confidences''' it became quite plain to me I had been represented to the wife of the high dignitary, and goodness knows to how many more people besides, as an exceptional and gifted creature - a piece of good fortune for the Company - a man you don’t get hold of every day.}}
# {{lb|en|dated}} [[boldness|Boldness]]; [[presumption]].
